title: Mother tried to protect daughter's property rights in 1987; 39 years later, court rules against her
summary_full: A property transfer made by a Queens mother in 1987 led to a legal dispute nearly four decades later. Mary Mangiaracina had tried to secure lifetime rights to the Ridgewood property for herself and her daughter. However, after the property was sold to new owners, her daughter challenged the sale-related ownership claims in court. In April 2026, a New York appeals court ruled that the daughter had never legally received those lifetime rights.
